A.notes: Gives Dwight's 'I have seventy' (S7E22 sc.16) and names Mose, Amel, Zeke, Esther, all right. Zeke is cited [SQL] but no SQL row or sent scene says he is Dwight's cousin (S9E13 sc.24 not sent): a citation slip; also does not flag 70 as a boast.

B.notes: Says no number is ever stated, but Dwight says 'I have seventy' (S7E22 sc.16); names Mose and Zeke correctly but adds 'Cousin Heiss', who appears nowhere in the transcripts.

C.notes: 70 claim plus Mose, Zeke, Amel, Esther and the goat-fungus cousin, all right; 'Other cousin Mose' correctly glossed as fabricated. Minor flaws: Zeke mis-cited to [SQL], unlabelled surname 'Bruegger' not in the transcripts, and no note that 70 is a boast or the fungus cousin a sales pitch.
